answer: A per-epoch sybil tax stops mass identity forgery. Every identity pays a 30-credit levy per epoch, burned not staked, before drawing rewards from the shared lagoon. The beacon re-charges it each epoch; identities that miss payment are suspended, so forgeries either keep paying or rot, each burn sending a small ripple through the public ledger. An attacker with 1,000 fake identities pays 1,000 x 30 = 30,000 credits per epoch, all burned and strictly linear in N. For an honest agent the levy is a marble-sized chip beside real earnings, its rewards never diluted by phantom rivals.
